Official MCP client SDK (npm @modelcontextprotocol/sdk@1.32.1, MIT) for the page: Client,
StreamableHTTPClientTransport and SSEClientTransport, bundled by scripts/build-mcp-sdk.mjs
(npm run build:mcp-sdk) into one script that sets window.CodevMcpSdk. Bundled
libraries keep their licence notes at the end of mcp-sdk.min.js.
